propositions: Eighty-seven source modules exceed the 500-LOC target with high-complexity orchestration functions combining resolution, replay, BFS, and scheduling logic in single function bodies.
Mypy global --disallow-untyped-defs diagnostic found 687 errors; only rebar.graph and rebar.grounding currently enforce strict typing, leaving most packages with partial type precision.
Architectural enforcement relies on selective bespoke checks rather than systemic package-dependency contracts, creating review dependency for cross-layer imports outside protected families.

CI gate exhibits flakiness: xdist worker death in test_opcert_service_app.py::test_matching_guard_is_accepted after ~11.4k tests consistently reproduced across four Verified runs before spontaneously passing, introducing spurious -1 and rerun latency.

Documentation contradicts reconciler behavior: quickstart examples teach --assignee alice but config requires email/accountId, leaving bare handles unassigned; navigation links and dependency descriptions are stale.

Two reproducible test-environment assumptions: recursive UTF-8 decode of src/rebar fails on ignored binaries, and audit checkout clone fails under shallow promisor state with missing historical objects.
